text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O has finished
her first three years in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She went on to achieve truly spectacular results—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O-san!
Which race do you intend to enter next?!
Are you aiming for a rematch with Maruzensky-san?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Is it true you promised Yaeno-san and Ardan-san to run in a certain GⅠ race together?! Do you have other secret rivals as well!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah wah... Um, excuse me.
Please, one question per person!!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Chiyo-chaaan!
Look over here~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaah, so cute!
She really is the nation's little sister Umamusume! Lemme hug you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A-A hug!? A national...!?
Wh-What... Th-Thank you so much!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hello... e-ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san,
would you take a look at my training sometime?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Ah, no fair, me, me! I'm first, right, Chiyo-senpai?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Yes!
It's Chiyo-senpai!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
T-T-T-Trainer!!
Please, you have to help me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
People have been acting so strange toward me lately!
Out of nowhere, they've started putting me on a pedestal...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's true that public interest in Sakura Chiyono O
has been surging rapidly as of late.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just the other day, the academy received an offer
for a serialized TV drama called "The Sakura Chiyono O Story."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Y-You're not going to tell me... this was all a hidden camera prank, are you? Or is it a dream?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh~? No way~...
Still, I really can't believe what's going on right now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, the whole mood was all about the "Eternal Big Three," wasn't it?
And yet, all of a sudden...
choice_data_list: Chiyono O did beat the "Eternal Big Three," after all.
Chiyono O did beat the "Eternal Big Three," after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
B-But, but besides that,
wasn't Maruzen-san the one stealing the spotlight!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Then shouldn't Maruzen-san
be the one featured in magazines and on TV?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Just out of curiosity, though...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Am I doing something pretty amazing?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's why everyone is
so captivated by Chiyo-chan.
It's truly Chiyo-chan fever.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So, Chiyo-chan. What about that mock race?
I already got the okay from him over there.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So, Chiyo-chan. What about that mock race?
I already got the okay from her over there.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...! Really, Trainer-san!?
I can run against Maruzen-san!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...!
Please do, Maruzen-san!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's blast through today too~! Let's see how much stronger Chiyo-chan's gotten~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Right back at you, Maruzen-san!
I'm not gonna lose today either!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Fufu.
...That's my line, you know♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Chiyo-chan's Trainer,
we're counting on you for the signal. Ready...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you sure you don't mind
not competing against the two of them?"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes. Because I'll be taking on the challenge in the real thing.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Until that time comes, I shall store them up:
my desire and strength to triumph over them.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I imagine the same goes for you?
Ardan-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...Fufu, after all, we are "rivals" too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I watch over Sakura Chiyono O running alongside Maruzensky. For her, this race is the continuation of her dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If I were to meet her past self and tell her, she'd probably be shocked and think it sounded like a total pipe dream.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
When I saw that person run, I thought to myself:
I want to become like Maruzen-san too,
and stand side by side with her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No matter how mediocre an Umamusume I might be, that dream is the one thing I refuse to give up...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...Amazing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Midway through Sakura Chiyono O and the others' race,
the voice of an unfamiliar Umamusume reached our ears.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...I want to compete with her too.
I wonder what it'd be like if I ran desperately just like her.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I wonder if I'll find racing fun...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O was now in the position
of being the one to inspire dreams in others.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text: Chiyo~! Sorry! They asked for another autograph board!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~!? I gave you 100 tickets just the other day, didn't I!?
Did you really go through all of them? No way!
There's no way that's true!!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"It's not a lie! If it's too much trouble, a handprint is fine.
Just slam your hand down on a signature board like Dad!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh~... Mm-mm-mm.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'll write it out properly instead of using a handprint.
After all, those people asked my mom because they wanted my autograph, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Then I have to live up to those expectations!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Chiyo. Mom's been thinking... You have a habit of calling yourself 'ordinary,' don't you?

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's precisely because Chiyo was so ordinary,
that she was able to become a star everyone could dream of.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's ordinary... it's still a very special star.
So keep doing your best, Chiyo.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...! Fufu, yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(I was ordinary, yet yearned to be special.
By meeting the people who supported me,
I was able to make my special dream come true.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (The only reason I managed that, though, was probably...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"You can make desserts even with just a ladle and a pot"...
I guess.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I just came up with a great proverb.
I'd better write it down!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the story of Sakura Chiyono O continues—
